title: Finite etale direct image preserves locally constant modules of finite type
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a finite etale morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $F$ be a sheaf of $R_Y$-modules on the small etale site of $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], where $R_T$ is the constant ring sheaf on a scheme $T$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Suppose $F$ is locally constant of finite type [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules]: etale locally it is isomorphic to a constant sheaf with value a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then the direct image $f_*F$, viewed as an $R_X$-module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], is locally constant of finite type in the same sense. No Noetherian hypothesis on the schemes or the coefficient ring and no finiteness of the underlying sets of $R$ or the module values is required.
